chunks: I asked al-Riḍā عليه السلام about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
Surely Allah commands you to render the trusts to their rightful owners.

He عليه السلام said: They are the Imams from the family of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله, such that the Imam is to deliver the trust to the one after him, not single out anyone else with it, and not withhold it from him.

key_terms.آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: the family of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.الرِّضَا: Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام, the one being asked about the verse
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةُ: the Imams عليهم السلام from the family of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.الْأَمَانَاتِ: the trusts; here, the entrusted office and authority of Imamate
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the divinely designated Imam who conveys the trust to his successor
key_terms.قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: the statement of Allah in the Qur'an
key_terms.مَنْ بَعْدَهُ: the one who comes after him as the rightful successor
key_terms.يَزْوِيَهَا: to withhold or keep it away

ai.seo_question: How do the Imams عليهم السلام interpret the verse 'Allah commands you to render trusts to their owners'?
ai.summary: This narration explains the verse about rendering trusts as referring to the Imams from the family of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله. The trust is interpreted as the divinely entrusted authority and office of Imamate, which each Imam must pass to the rightful succeeding Imam without diverting it to another.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washha, from Ahmad Bin Umar who said, 
‘I asked Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> about the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[4:58] Surely Allah Commands you to make over trusts to their owners.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They<sup>asws</sup> are the Imams<sup>asws</sup> from the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> that they<sup>asws</sup> had over the entrustment from after him<sup>saww</sup>, and He<sup>azwj</sup> did not Particularise other than him<sup>asws</sup> with it, nor impeded it from him<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 2. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Washsha’ from Ahmad ibn ‘Umar who has said that I asked abu al-Hassan al-Rida (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High.
“Allah (God) commands you to return that which had been entrusted to you to the rightful owners. Be just when passing judgment among people. . .” [4:58]

The Imam (a.s.) said, “They are the Imams (a.s.) from the family of Muhammad (s.a.) who are commanded to deliver the trust to the succeeding Imam (a.s.) exclusively and to no one else and that the succeeding Imams must not be deprived of this trust.”
